editorial.blurb: Ikigai brings together pristine sushi and vibrant izakaya energy in a neighborhood favorite where fresh fish and friendly service make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Sit at the sushi counter if you can—the head chef Jeff is delightful, and you'll watch the nigiri come together. Don't miss the hamachi crudo and futo maki, and pair them with one of their excellent cocktails.
